name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear, high-contrast focus indicators even on mobile or low-vision screens. The trade-off is slightly larger ring size, but it improves usability without clutter.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—users see a faint ring that disappears against backgrounds. Alternative: 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a 1px solid border at 7:1. Settle with a live test: measure visibility for 5 users toggling both modes on 3 devices.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px solid border at 7:1 contrast. This keeps the ring visible in both normal and high-contrast modes while staying compact. The trade-off is a slightly more complex style rule, but it guarantees usability for users who toggle both reduced motion and high contrast.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 2px ring with a 1px border risks looking like a double ring on some screens, breaking visual consistency. Better alternative: 3px ring at 7:1 contrast, but add a 0.5px inset shadow at 4.5:1 for reduced-motion users. Settle with a live test: measure ring clarity for 5 users toggling reduced motion on 3 devices.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default, with a 0.5px inset shadow at 4.5:1 for reduced-motion users. Deliver a tested, documented focus ring style in EXCAVA’s style system. Owner: Ramp.
